info.title: makod — MaKo process engine
info.description:
German energy market process engine (BDEW EDI@Energy / MaKo).

Implements the full EDIFACT ingest pipeline, ERP command gateway, and administrative APIs for MaLo cache and partner directory management.

422.description: malo_id in path does not match maloId in body

get.summary: `GET /admin/partners` — list all partner records for this tenant.

post.summary:
`POST /admin/partners/import` — import partners from a raw PARTIN EDIFACT
interchange.
post.description:
Accepts a raw EDIFACT interchange (`Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8`
or `application/edifact`). Each PARTIN message in the interchange is parsed,
the sender's communication data (MP-ID, AS4 endpoint, email, phone) is
extracted, and the result is upserted into the [`PartnerStore`].

This endpoint is idempotent — reimporting the same interchange is safe and
will update existing records according to the `valid_from` merge rules of
[`PartnerRecord::merge_from_partin`].

Returns a JSON summary of how many records were upserted/skipped.

put.summary: `PUT /admin/partners/{mp_id}` — create or update a partner record.
put.description:
The `gln` in the path must match `record.mp_id` in the body; a mismatch is
rejected with `400 Bad Request`.

202.description: Command accepted, or the recorded response for a repeated Idempotency-Key

404.description: No active process for the referenced business key

409.description: duplicate_process (adopt the returned process_id) or invalid_state

422.description: Unknown command, missing marktrolle, missing or reused Idempotency-Key, or an invalid payload

501.description: Command registered but not dispatchable in this release

503.description: The idempotency record could not be read; retry

get.summary:
Which of the operator's archived messages candidate `fv` would newly
refuse.

200.description: The impact report; text/csv on ?format=csv or Accept: text/csv

get.description:
Returns the BO4E `Rechnung` object embedded in the `WimInvoicReceived`
event for the given process.

- **200 OK** — JSON `Rechnung` (BO4E v202607 schema)
- **404 Not Found** — process does not exist or has no `InvoicReceived` event
- **422 Unprocessable Entity** — `process_id` is not a valid UUID
- **500** — the stream could not be read, or its `WimInvoicReceived` event
  carries no `rechnung` (the adapter embeds one on every such event, so its
  absence is a malformed stream, not an invoice that has yet to arrive)

404.description: No such process, or no INVOIC received on it

500.description: The stream could not be read or is malformed

200.description: The policy report: each `[policy]` setting with its value and source, `deployment.rollen`, every `allow_*` posture

post.description:
`200` carries the verdict whether the message passes or not: the rehearsal
ran. A refusal *to rehearse* — an unknown command, one whose door cannot be
stopped before it writes, a Marktrolle the deployment does not declare — is
a `422` naming it. No Idempotency-Key: nothing is written, so a repeat is
another rehearsal.

200.description: The rehearsal ran: the verdict and the message the door built

422.description: Unknown command, a command that cannot be rehearsed, or a Marktrolle the deployment does not declare

200.description: Ingest report: at least one message accepted

500.description: A refusal's dead letter could not be written; resubmit

get.summary:
Liveness probe — reports that the process is running and its HTTP stack
responds.
get.description:
Deliberately checks nothing else. A dependency this handler could fail on is
a dependency a restart would not fix, and Kubernetes answers a liveness
failure with a restart.

get.summary: Readiness probe — reports whether this instance can serve traffic.
get.description:
Fails while a startup step registered as a [`ReadinessGate`] has not
finished, when the event store is unreachable, or when a background worker
has stopped heartbeating, because in each case an accepted message would not
be processed to the point of durability or answered from current data.

200.description: Store is alive and all workers are healthy

503.description: Store is unavailable or a worker has stalled

ApiError.description: The problem body every refusal answers with. Branch on `code`; `detail` is for the developer.

code.description: A stable English machine code (`limit_too_large`), where the refusal has one.

detail.description: What went wrong, for the developer.

error_id.description: On a 5xx: the id the service's log line carries; the cause is never in the body.

upstream.description: On a 502/503/504: the service this one called that failed.

CandidateInfo.description: One message type of the candidate.

against.description: The binding Formatversion it is compared with.

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key echoed back to the caller.

message_ref.description:
The reference of the message this command filed (`UNH` DE 0062), when
the command files one whose reference is fixed at acceptance —
`mabis.summenzeitreihe.uebermitteln`. It is what the counterparty's
answer names, so a caller records it rather than a placeholder.

process_id.description:
UUID of the process that was spawned or updated.

Matches the `subject` field of the corresponding CloudEvent sent to the
ERP webhook. Use this to correlate the command response with the
`de.mako.engine.process.initiated` (or other) event the ERP received.

ErpCommand.description:
Inbound ERP command envelope.

The ERP explicitly names the MaKo process command it wants to trigger and
its own Marktrolle.  The BO4E object(s) carrying domain data are placed in
`payload` — they are never used for routing.

marktrolle.description:
Marktrolle of the ERP system issuing this command.

**Required only for multi-role commands** such as
`wim.geraetewechsel.beauftragen` (permitted for both `NB` and `MSB`).
For single-role commands (e.g. `gpke.lieferbeginn.anmelden` → always `LF`)
this field is optional — the role is inferred from the command name.

Examples: `"NB"`, `"LF"`, `"LFG"`, `"GNB"`, `"MSB"`, `"BKV"`, `"ÜNB"`

payload.description:
Command-specific payload.

Each command defines its own required fields.  For most GPKE/GeLi
commands the minimal payload is a `malo_id` string (the 11-digit
Marktlokations-ID) plus the process-specific date.  The engine
resolves all partner MP-IDs (NB, MSB) and MeLo data from the MaLo cache.

Example for `gpke.lieferbeginn.anmelden`
(`mako_markt::commands::GpkeLieferbeginnAnmelden`, every field Muss on
the 55001):
```json
{
  "malo_id":            "51238696012",
  "lieferbeginn_datum": "2026-10-01",
  "transaktionsgrund":  "E03",
  "bilanzkreis":        "11XBK-LF-------9",
  "haushaltskunde":     true,
  "enfg_grundlage":     "ZG1",
  "kunde": { "nachname": "Mustermann", "anschrift": { "strasse": "Hauptstraße",
             "hausnummer": "1", "postleitzahl": "50667", "ort": "Köln", "landescode": "DE" } }
}
```

Not a BO4E document: this is a **command** envelope, and each command
names the scalar fields it reads out of it (see the module docs). Even
the invoicing commands are flat — `makod` renders the INVOIC envelope
with an empty detail section and never holds an invoice's positions.

**Never include** `sender_party_id`, `receiver_party_id`, `pruefidentifikator`, or
`message_ref` — these are engine-owned and will be ignored or rejected.

reason.description:
Present only when `status == "degraded"`. Stable category string — never
contains internal paths or stack traces.

status.description: `"ok"` when the probe passes; `"degraded"` when it does not.

Impact.description: The impact report of one candidate Formatversion.

candidates.description: Every message type the candidate covers.

message_types_not_covered.description: Interchanges of a message type no candidate covers, per type.

not_revalidated.description:
Messages not re-validated because the candidate does not change their
Prüfidentifikator, per PID (`ohne` for none).

pid_changes.description: Messages whose Prüfidentifikator the candidate removes or adds.

refusals.description: Each new refusal, one row per rule.

ImpactRow.description: One new refusal of one message.

bedingungen.description: Every Bedingung the place cites, with the candidate AHB's text.

builder.description:
For an outbound message: what in mako builds it, since mako itself must
change before the Stichtag.

rule_status.description: The candidate AHB's status and operands for the place.

segment.description: The segment tag the refusal sits on.

segment_position.description: One-based position of the segment in its message, `UNH` = 1.

skipped.description: Number of PARTIN messages that had no extractable MP-ID.

upserted.description: Number of PARTIN records successfully upserted.

accepted.description: Number of messages that were parsed and routed (or had a known PID).

rejected.description: Number of messages that could not be parsed at all.

error.description:
Human-readable error, present when `status` is `"parse_error"` or
`"dispatch_failed"`.

malo_id.description:
Marktlokations-ID extracted from the message (LOC+Z16), if present.

Use this to correlate the ingest response with the corresponding
command API call (`gpke.lieferbeginn.bestaetigen` etc.).

message_type.description:
EDIFACT message type, e.g. `"UTILMD"`, `"MSCONS"`, `"APERAK"`.
`null` when the message type could not be determined (parse error).

pid.description:
The Prüfidentifikator extracted from the BGM segment, if present.
`null` for message types that carry no PID (e.g. CONTRL).

process_id.description:
UUID of the process that was spawned or resumed.

Matches the `subject` of the `de.mako.engine.process.initiated` CloudEvent
sent to the ERP webhook. Present only when `status == "routed"` and
Phase 2 dispatch succeeded.

workflow.description:
Workflow name from the `PidRouter`, if the PID is registered.
`null` when `pid` is `null` or when the PID is not registered.

PidChange.description: A message whose Prüfidentifikator one of the two releases lacks.

grund.description:
The refusal in the door's own words — the sentence the real command
would be answered with.

marktrolle.description: The Marktrolle it was rehearsed as.

nachrichten.description: The messages the door built; empty when it refused before building one.

oneOf.description: Where the refusal came from; absent when the message passes.

ProbeBefund.description: One finding of the pre-send check.

element.description:
Zero-based index into the segment's `elemente`, where the finding
names a data element.

komponente.description: Zero-based component within that data element.

regel.description: The profile rule it rests on (`AHB-…`, `MIG-…`), where it names one.

ahb_version.description: The AHB version of that profile.

befunde.description: Findings the check placed on no single segment.

empfaenger.description: The MP-ID it is addressed to.

formatversion.description: The format version whose profile named the segments (`FV2025-10-01`).

marktrolle.description:
The Marktrolle to rehearse as — required only where the command is
permitted for more than one, as on `POST /api/v1/commands`.

payload.description: The command's payload, exactly as `POST /api/v1/commands` takes it.

ProbeSegment.description: One segment of the rendered message.

befunde.description: The findings that sit on this segment.

elemente.description: Each data element as written, components joined by `:`.

gruppe.description: The segment groups enclosing the place, outermost first (`SG4/SG8`).

name.description: The MIG's name for the place; absent when the segment fits no place.

nr.description: The MIG's running number of the place the segment sits at.

text.description: The segment as it goes on the wire, terminator included.

UpsertRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /admin/malo/{malo_id}`.

The server scopes all operations to its configured operator MP-ID;
the request body must not include a `tenant_id` — the tenant is
always the operator that holds the bearer token.

result.description: Full positive MaLo identification result from the UTILMD query process.

valid_from.description: Optional ISO 8601 effective-from date (informational; not enforced).

Urteil.description: What the pre-send check says about a rehearsed command.

Window.description: The first and last day read.

bearer_token.description: Named API key provisioned with `--auth-key NAME=TOKEN` (env: MAKOD_AUTH_KEYS). Pass as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
